boundary: Controlled engineering latency benchmark on one real 180 s record. It compares serial causal wrappers, not published batch throughput or detection accuracy.

orientation_metadata.resampling_incomplete_history: NaN until complete FIR support is available

protocol.cspp: Process the new 50-sample packet once and retain causal normalization and recurrent state.
protocol.eqtransformer: At each packet, recompute the latest fully historical 6000-sample window, including its frozen filter.
protocol.phase_net: At each packet, recompute the latest fully historical 3001-sample window.
protocol.sta_lta: Process the new 50-sample packet once and retain causal normalization and recursive energy state.
protocol.synchronization: Every selected scalar output is materialized with Tensor.item().
